name: Mirror of the Simurgh
body:
Price 400,000 gp; Slot none CL 10th; Weight 1 ton; Aura moderate abjuration and divination

DESCRIPTION

This round, plain polished full-figure silver mirror was created to help both mortals and immortals in their path to enlightenment. Whoever looks in the mirror of the simurgh sees their true soul rather than its physical appearance, and can learn many things about illumination.

Each image visible in the mirror shows the creature’s alignment, emotion, health and magic aura, and is not fooled by spells and effects that alter auras. A creature seeing its image gains a glimpse of future rewards or punishments caused by its actions. A good creature is elated from this vision, gaining a +2 morale bonus on attack rolls, saves, and skill checks for the next 24 hours.

An evil creature is shaken and suffers an equal penalty for the same time; alternatively, it can accept an immediate atonement to change its alignment. A neutral viewer suffers half the penalty (-1 on attack rolls, saves, and skill checks) if it doesn’t accept an atonement.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Cost 200,000 gp; Feats Craft Wondrous Item; Spells analyze aura, early judgment, creator must be a simurgh
